controls: Restrict ACL by service and purpose; workflows never accept client asserted roles

Unique SharePoint Key enforced in each list
SharePoint version history enabled but not sole business history
No unbounded head JSON; size and list threshold qualification before pilot
Staged artifacts only become authoritative when referenced by CAS committed PlanHead
Actual source policies and retention must be approved by CHHHS
Approved copy PDF/Word in restricted records-managed library, not Git
